headline: Dua Associates advises Odyssey Energy Solutions on availing €7 million ECB from BIO
sum: Odyssey Energy Solutions Procure VI Pvt. Ltd., a group entity of Odyssey Energy Solutions, Inc., has availed €7 million external commercial borrowing (ECB) facility from the Belgian Investment Company for Developing Countries SA (BIO).
detail: Odyssey Energy Solutions Procure VI Pvt. Ltd., a group entity of Odyssey Energy Solutions, Inc., has availed €7 million external commercial borrowing (ECB) facility from the Belgian Investment Company for Developing Countries SA (BIO). Dua Associates advised Odyssey on this transaction. The Firm's role included negotiation, finalisation and execution of the transaction documentation.
